one_line: Corporate spend and expense management platform with a REST API for transactions, reimbursements, vendors, cards, and accounting exports.
auth_notes: API keys issued from the Ramp dashboard; requires an active Ramp business account (corporate card/expense product, paid). API access is gated behind account onboarding and approval.
self_serve_notes: Requires a Ramp account — no free API tier. Credentials are self-issuable from the dashboard once the org is approved, but company signup/underwriting is required.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Roughly 50-100 endpoints covering transactions, reimbursements, entities/vendors, cards, limits, accounting sync, and webhook subscriptions.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported for transaction and other spend events.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers for Ramp exist; no confirmed official MCP.

evidence.note: No fetched text file existed for this app; facts from domain knowledge. Docs URL confirmed reachable via curl.

agent_notes: API-key auth and webhook support from knowledge of Ramp docs; account gating makes it buildable_with_work rather than buildable_today.
